title: Derivative lower bound below critical bias
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $p	ext{ and }p_c$ are real numbers with $0<p<1$, $0\le p_c\le1$, and $p\le p_c$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ has value $1/2$ at $p_c$. Then its derivative at $p$ is at least its value at $p$ divided by $2p$.
